bull_bear.body:
- Growth guidance sets "Disciplined Leverage & Balance Sheet" alongside 20-25% annual revenue growth targeted over the next three years and a "Strong EBITDA Margin of 37-38%".
- Chairman states "our balance sheet improved to net debt of 0.87 times equity, inside the limit we have set"; net debt to equity is shown as 1.17, 0.90, 0.92, 0.9 and 0.87 for Mar-23 through Q1FY27 against secured term loans of ₹731 / 753 / 1,015 / 1,238 / 1,317 Mn.
- Debt repayment (₹ Mn) shown for FY23-Q1FY27 as 415, 376, 334, 365 and 105; interest coverage ratio shown as 2.6x, 4.0x, 5.6x, 10.3x and 8.4x.
- Net cash flow from operations (₹ Mn) shown as 424, 462, 562 and 693 for FY23-FY26, against investing outflows of -263, -553, -577 and -783 — i.e. cash generation reinvested into fleet.
- Subsidiary funding kept small: Tarachand Metallix initial capital ₹25 Lakhs, funded by ₹25 Lakhs cash consideration for 2.5 Lakhs shares at ₹10 FV.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as a "Leading service provider deploying large-tonnage cranes, piling rigs and aerial working platforms" and a "Leader in steel warehousing with 4 decades of expertise", serving urban infra, railways, oil & gas, cement, renewables and roads & highways.
- Differentiation claimed via a fleet led by a 900 MT all-terrain crane, 900 MT crawler cranes and 68 metre aerial work platforms, plus "the only self-owned Rubber Tyre Gantries in the industry"; the deck asserts "High-capability equipment creates entry barriers and commands premium yields."
- Scale markers on the overview slide: 40+ years of experience, 400+ owned & operated fleet, 5 steel stockyards managed, 7+ sectors served, 22 states covered and 50+ clients served.
- Structured as holding company TCISL across Equipment Hiring & Projects, Warehousing & Transportation and Steel Processing & Distribution, plus subsidiary Metallix — "An integrated infra-logistics platform with a forward-integrated service arm".
- Deliberate scope limit: the SUSTAIN pillar is "Focused on specialized contracts across Equipment Rentals and Warehousing Logistic segments while taking a conscious decision to stay away from run of the mill EPC projects".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary] Tarachand Metallix Limited, a 100% wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated Jan 06, 2026 in Maharashtra, is a metal processing & manufacturing platform building high frequency beams, fabrication & cutting and value-added metal solutions — described as "Forward integration beyond logistics into manufacturing/service" leveraging the existing client network.
- [Guidance] Chairman flags a phased year: "I expect the first half to run below our usual 37% to 38% margin and to recover over the second half, as the affected equipment returns to work and specialized services steadies towards the end of the second quarter."
- [Dispute] A client-led change in project scope left equipment idle and nearly halved specialised-services margin in the quarter; the company is "pursuing a fair settlement of the resulting losses".
- [Listing history] Listed on NSE Emerge in 2018, crossed ₹100 crore revenue in FY19, and migrated to the NSE Main Board in 2024.
- [Contract history] Long-dated anchor contracts cited include a 1991 SAIL Chandigarh stockyard contract, a ₹160 crore order from Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Ltd (2020), a 7-year RINL Nagpur contract from 2023, and a 4.5-year warehousing and steel handling contract at SAIL Stockyard, Bangalore (2024).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions as an integrated infra-logistics platform built on high-tonnage owned equipment rental and steel warehousing, with four decades of experience and a stated strategy of SCALE, SPECIALISE, SUSTAIN.

rows.text: completes the purchase of an **800 MT crawler crane, a 700 MT all-terrain crane and two 58-metre aerial platforms**, to be deployed against renewable-energy and petrochemical orders. The **Rs 74.20 crore** it cites is FY27 capex **to date**, not the price of these four machines, which the filing does not state.
